description: Search the messages of all your rooms (or one room) stored on this machine, after fetching what is new. Matches words in the text or attachment names, case-insensitively, and returns the newest matches with their room. Rooms whose older history isn't stored yet are named in the last line.

as.description: Identity slug to act as (default: the active identity)

from.description: Only messages from this member (slug or display name)

query.description: Words to find; may be empty when a filter is given

room.description: roomId or index from huddo_list, for this call only (default: the default room)

since.description: Only messages after this: a date (2026-10-19) or a span back from now (30m, 12h, 3d, 2w)

until.description: Only messages before this, same format as since

name: huddo_search
